primaryTextChecks.text: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
primaryTextChecks.decision: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

primaryTextChecks.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, like David his father,
primaryTextChecks.decision: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, like David his father,

primaryTextChecks.text: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.
primaryTextChecks.decision: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

primaryTextChecks.text: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against the LORD.
primaryTextChecks.decision: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against the LORD.

primaryTextChecks.text: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the LORD’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.
primaryTextChecks.decision: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the LORD’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.

primaryTextChecks.text: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz.
primaryTextChecks.decision: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz.

primaryTextChecks.text: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
primaryTextChecks.decision: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

primaryTextChecks.text: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
primaryTextChecks.decision: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

primaryTextChecks.text: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before the LORD’s altar.”
